label: s9-c517-memory-contracts-controlled

assertionCoverage.name: MF3-01 reach resolution is owner-bounded
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.deepEqual(reach, [{ scope: 'global', ownerId: null }, { scope: 'workspace', ownerId: null }]);
assertionCoverage.clause: Valid reachability uses the permitted Scope/owner pairs.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production reach resolver is called with a Workspace-only context and its exact valid global/workspace pairs are asserted.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-07-003/107: explicit save validates invalid scope, category, sources, and owners before duplicate lookup
assertionCoverage.clause: Invalid Scope/owner combinations are rejected by the production boundary.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The route submits invalid Scope and owner envelopes through the real HTTP endpoint and asserts the production 400 response for every case.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-03 automatic candidate without source rejects
assertionCoverage.clause: An automatic candidate without a source is refused.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production candidate repository receives agent-derived content with an empty source list and the test asserts SOURCE_REQUIRED; the same test separately permits user-explicit content.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-03 automatic candidate without source rejects
assertionCoverage.clause: The source gate does not misclassify an explicitly user-authored save.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production repository result is read back after the explicit-user exception, proving the automatic-source rule is scoped to automatic content.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-09 conflict open and resolve
assertionCoverage.clause: An opened conflict can be explicitly resolved.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository opens a persisted conflict and the production resolution path returns its resolved status.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-21 keep-both releases both conflicted entries
assertionCoverage.clause: Explicit keep-both resolution preserves both sides.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production conflict resolver records the selected disposition and the test reads that durable decision.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-23 reject-both rejects both sides
assertionCoverage.clause: Explicit reject-both resolution applies the recorded effects to both entries.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production resolver returns both persisted status transitions and the assertion checks the complete effect list.

assertionCoverage.name: MF3-04 ranking is deterministic and order-independent
assertionCoverage.clause: Ranking is deterministic regardless of input order.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production ranking function receives the same candidates in both orders and the exact ordered IDs are compared.

assertionCoverage.name: MF3-05 pin dominates and is explained
assertionCoverage.clause: A ranking decision carries a direct explanation.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production ranking result is inspected for the concrete pin reason rather than inferred from a source symbol.

assertionCoverage.name: MF3-06 conflict penalty and FTS reason
assertionCoverage.clause: FTS contribution is explained in the ranking result.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production ranker is exercised with an FTS score and the returned reason list is asserted.

assertionCoverage.name: frozen injection survives content edits and logical deletion of its Entry
assertionCoverage.clause: Later Entry content edits do not rewrite an existing Context Snapshot.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production resolver is replayed after a persisted Entry content/version change and its returned context is compared with the frozen context.

assertionCoverage.name: frozen injection survives content edits and logical deletion of its Entry
assertionCoverage.clause: The persisted snapshot payload cannot be overwritten through the database mutation guard.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The test attempts the prohibited production payload mutation and observes the durable IMMUTABLE rejection.

assertionCoverage.name: MF-5 memory-context by id: frozen snapshot with selection and exclusion reasons
assertionCoverage.clause: Selected Entries expose their selection reasons.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production memory-context endpoint is queried and the returned persisted snapshot reason list is compared exactly.

assertionCoverage.name: MF-5 memory-context by id: frozen snapshot with selection and exclusion reasons
assertionCoverage.clause: Excluded Entries expose their exclusion reasons.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The same production endpoint returns an exclusion and the exact persisted exclusion reason is asserted.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-G1 completed Run generates a review-required Candidate with bounded evidence
assertionCoverage.clause: Terminal-run promotion does not include raw Provider history.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production terminal generator creates the Candidate and the persisted content is directly checked for absence of the raw-provider payload.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-G5 non-terminal or unknown Run generates nothing
assertionCoverage.clause: Non-terminal execution does not bulk-promote transcript content.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production generator is called for a running Run and the repository is queried to verify that no Candidate was created.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-G6 failed Run generates one bounded failure Candidate, idempotent per Run
assertionCoverage.clause: Failure candidates also exclude raw Provider history.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production failure generator is exercised and its actual Candidate content is checked for the same boundary.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-04 review-required triggers
assertionCoverage.clause: A candidate marked for Scope promotion enters review-required rather than automatic acceptance.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production promotion gate is exercised with its explicit scopePromotion flag and the returned decision is asserted for the named promotion case.

assertionCoverage.name: MF2R-16 merge rejects scope or owner leakage
assertionCoverage.clause: A cross-Scope merge is rejected without mutating the target Entry.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production review/merge path receives a workspace-scoped candidate for a task-scoped Entry and the test asserts the fail-closed rejection.

assertionCoverage.name: MF-2 explicit user save: creates the Entry and one Workspace Event in one transaction
assertionCoverage.clause: The real save route creates a user-explicit Entry.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production HTTP save route is called and the returned durable Entry authority is asserted.

assertionCoverage.name: MF-2 explicit user save: creates the Entry and one Workspace Event in one transaction
assertionCoverage.clause: The save emits the canonical Workspace Event.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production database is queried after the route call and the exact persisted event type is asserted.

assertionCoverage.name: MF-2 explicit user save: creates the Entry and one Workspace Event in one transaction
assertionCoverage.clause: The saved Entry is retrievable through the production retrieval path.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The test calls the real retrieval endpoint and matches the actual saved Entry by ID and authority.

assertionCoverage.name: MF-2 explicit user save: creates the Entry and one Workspace Event in one transaction
assertionCoverage.clause: A duplicate save converges rather than creating a second Entry.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The same production route is called again with the same content and the response explicitly reports convergence.
